mechanics.claim: Viktor may freely act while the ray is traveling.
mechanics.quote: '''Viktor''' may freely act while the ray is traveling.

mechanics.claim: The affected area is set upon casting; the beam does not break off even if Viktor moves.
mechanics.quote: The effected area is set upon casting, no matter how far away '''Viktor''' moves. Unlike a leash, ''Hextech Ray'' will not break off its own effect.

mechanics.claim: If the laser is blocked by a spell shield/wall as it hits the ground, it is intercepted; Viktor can cast over a wall without interception.
mechanics.quote: If ''Hextech Ray'' is {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}, the initial ray is not destroyed.

mechanics.claim: The Aftershock explosion still covers the entire target area even if the laser itself was blocked.
mechanics.quote: ''Augmented Hextech Ray'' will still cause the entire target area to explode even if the laser is blocked.

mechanics.claim: If Viktor dies while firing the beam, it only deals damage up to the location at the time of his death.
mechanics.quote: If '''Viktor''' dies while he is firing the beam it only deals damage up to the location at the time of his death.

mechanics.claim: The Aftershock explosion occurs after a 1 second delay along the beam's wake.
mechanics.quote: The path explodes along the beam's wake after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
